description_th: Deep preset for insurance product education, trust rebuilding, claims concerns, agent/channel conflict, and regulated communication.
description_en: Deep preset for insurance product education, trust rebuilding, claims concerns, agent/channel conflict, and regulated communication.
campaign_duration: 8-12 weeks education and lead generation window
budget_range: THB 2M-12M test budget; replace with approved media and agent plan
primary_kpi: Trust lift, quote intent, objection reduction, claim concern rate
competitor_context: Traditional insurers, bank assurance, price-comparison platforms, digital-first challengers, and agent-led local competitors.
brand_constraints: Avoid guaranteed payout language, hidden exclusions, fear-based pressure, or confusing financial/medical claims.
risk_legal_notes: Review OIC, PDPA, policy wording, claims examples, testimonial disclosures, and agent compliance rules.

archetypes.narrative_th: Wants protection for family but worries about exclusions, premium burden, and whether claims will really be paid.
Compares premiums online and suspects insurers hide exclusions in small print.
Has filed a claim before and evaluates brands by claims service, not slogans.
Trusts known local agents and community referrals more than digital ads.

crisis_scenarios.trigger: A customer posts a viral story claiming the insurer denied a claim unfairly.
Users accuse a campaign of hiding exclusions behind simple benefit language.
The brand publishes simple claims examples and decision criteria with careful disclaimers.

document_seeds.description_en: Starter brief for transparent insurance education.
document_seeds.content:
# Insurance Education Brief

Product: [product]
Objective: improve trust and qualified quote intent.
Audience: family planners, price comparison buyers, claim-experience skeptics.
Proof: clear policy examples, eligibility, exclusion summary, claims process.
Risks: overpromising, hidden exclusions, personal data collection, agent/channel conflict.
Validation: legal review, advisor review, claims team review, and segment objection test.

channel_behavior: Facebook and LINE carry claim stories quickly
TikTok can simplify but can also overpromise
deep_preset.sample_brief: Introduce a protection product by making claims eligibility and exclusions easier to understand without promising outcomes.
assumptions: This preset is a deterministic planning aid, not actuarial advice.
Regulatory and policy wording review is mandatory before launch.
limitations: Does not assess individual insurance suitability.
Does not estimate actual claims or portfolio risk.
